subject: Reintegration support and temporary coverage for Evelyn Hart
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Request: graduated return + accommodations (medical)

Hi Mina / Laura,

Thanks again for supporting me during my medical leave. My clinician, Dr. Petersen, cleared me to return with reduced hours and a phased ramp for 6 weeks. I attached the note and the signed accommodation form from my visit.

Proposed start: Monday, December 7.
Week 1-2: 3 days/week (Mon/Wed/Fri), 5 hours/day (10:00–15:00 PST) — focused on high-priority triage and async work only.
Week 3-4: 4 days/week, 6 hours/day.
Week 5-6: increase to 5 days/week, 7 hours/day.

I also need access to a private lactation room (pumping) and one guaranteed remote day per week at least for the first 8 weeks. Happy to discuss adjustments.

Please let me know what you need from me to make this official (forms, signatures, temporary task reassignments).

Thanks,
Evelyn
Senior Product Analyst
Redwood Inference

Attachments: doctor_note_petersen_20261123.pdf (pdf), accommodation_request_form.docx (docx)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Request: graduated return + accommodations (medical)

Evelyn — thank you for the note and the clear proposal, and welcome back (slowly). I uploaded the forms to the HR folder. Monica (HR) — can you confirm the next steps for intake, benefits coordination with Acme Benefits, and whether we need anything further from Dr. Petersen to process the accommodation?

Laura / Jonas — per the manager checklist, we need a temporary coverage plan, a point-person for triage while Evelyn is on reduced hours, and an agreement on performance expectations while ramping. Marcus Lin has bandwidth to pick up ad-hoc analytics tickets the first two weeks; Marcus, can you accept the assignment if Laura confirms?

Proposed immediate steps:
- Monica to open HR ticket and add Dr. Petersen's note to the employee file.
- Mina to send a templated reintegration plan (attached) and DocuSign for Evelyn's acknowledgment.
- Manager to confirm coverage and update OKRs for December.

I suggest a quick 30-min sync on Thursday to finalize. Available 10–12 PST.

— Mina
Sr. People Partner
Redwood Inference

Attachments: reinstatement_temporary_plan.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 13:08:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Request: graduated return + accommodations (medical)

Thanks, Mina. Evelyn — welcome back and thank you for the clear timeline. I agree with the proposed ramp. I confirm Marcus will pick up recurring analytics queues Dec 7–18 and Jonas will stand in for customer triage on Wed afternoons.

Manager commitments:
- Reduce Evelyn's meeting load to zero for Weeks 1–2 (calendar hold placed).
- Shift all synchronous customer calls to Jonas or Marcus for Weeks 1–2.
- Recalculate Q4 deliverables: move two lower-priority projects to Q1; update OKRs (I'll send edits to the OKR doc after our sync).
- Compensation: prorated bonus eligibility will remain intact; we will not penalize the review window for this temporary accommodation. HR/Comp please note.

Marcus — if that works, please reply-all to accept. I can set up a short onboarding handoff doc for the tasks.

— Laura
Director, Product Analytics
Redwood Inference

- Weeks 1–2: Mon/Wed/Fri 10:00–15:00 PST; no recurring meetings; Marcus assigned to analytics queue; Jonas covering Wed PM triage.
- Weeks 3–4: 4 days/week 10:00–16:00 PST; gradual calendar normalization.
- Pumping room: Facilities confirmed Room B-2 reserved (log on to Facilities portal).
- One guaranteed remote day each week for first 8 weeks.
- Benefits/comp: Compensation team confirmed prorated bonus eligibility; Monica will confirm in writing and update payroll records.
- Documentation: doctor_note_petersen_20261123.pdf and accommodation_request_form.docx have been added to the HR ticket (HR-Ticket-#45822).

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/sign/ABCDEF1234567890
